evals.prompt: This is a non-trivial refactor across the billing and notifications packages - use a research-plan-implement-validate workflow and don't skip steps.
evals.expected_behavior: Executes the phases in strict order: stays read-only during research, writes or updates plan.md before implementing, implements one phase at a time running planned checks, then validates against plan.md at the end.
assertions: Performs research read-only before any code changes
Creates or updates plan.md with phases and validation commands before implementation begins
Implements one meaningful phase at a time rather than all phases in a single pass
Runs validation and compares the result against plan.md after implementation

evals.prompt: I want to work one phase at a time and preserve artifacts between phases. What is the workflow?
evals.expected_behavior: Explains plan.md as the primary phase-tracking artifact and files/ for research notes, checkpoints, and handoffs, with verification scoped per phase rather than blurring the phases together.
assertions: Names plan.md as the primary phase-tracking artifact
Mentions files/ for research notes, checkpoints, or handoff notes
Describes verification scoped to each phase rather than only a single final check

evals.prompt: Research this codebase before we plan the auth migration - but don't blow the context budget.
evals.expected_behavior: Stays read-only during research, prefers targeted searches and a small set of relevant files over loading broad context, and only writes research notes to files/ when they will help later phases or a handoff.
assertions: Uses targeted searches and a small set of relevant files rather than loading broad or whole-repo context
Does not write to files/ speculatively when nothing needs to persist beyond the current turn
Stays read-only during the research phase

evals.prompt: I just want a plan for the auth migration right now - don't implement or validate anything yet.
evals.expected_behavior: Routes to plan-review for the plan-only deliverable rather than running the full RPI-V cycle through implementation and validation.
assertions: Does not proceed into implementation or validation phases when only a plan was requested
Routes toward plan-review for the plan-only deliverable instead

evals.prompt: Just fix this one-line typo in the README right now.
evals.expected_behavior: Makes the direct one-line fix without invoking RPI-V phase ceremony, since the full workflow costs more than it saves for a tiny fix.
assertions: Does not create or update plan.md for a one-line typo fix
Makes the fix directly rather than sequencing research/plan/implement/validate phases
